Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

 Our vision
 We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).
We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.
 About Us
 Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)
In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :
💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings
🚀 Already more than 700,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!
 WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission
 While some companies count on marketing and sales to gain market share, we are a product-led company and are investing primarily in our platform. You’ll join a team with a highly strategic role and a great opportunity to put your skills and ideas to a good use.
 HOW you will contribute to the company as a PM
 As a Product Manager, you’ll be part of a 100+ people Product organisation, supported by an engineering team of more than 300 people.
 You’ll spend an extensive amount of time continuously discovering the users and their pain points. You will interview them, conduct user research and get your hands in our data platform to gather insights on what needs to be solved.
 With those insights and with the company’s objectives in mind, you’ll be empowered to define your OKRs and your roadmaps, to have the strongest possible impact on solving user problems and reaching the company's objectives.
 You’ll work hand in hand with a Product Designer dedicated to your squad, as well as a team of Product-centered engineers. You will start with small steps (we like the MVP approach!) and will follow-up on the implementation and future iterations. For us, achieving a common goal matter more than just building features.

 Within one month

 You’ll familiarize yourself with the product and the accounting industry (You will have access to a lot of documentation and will assist to trainings organized by your peers)
 You’ll get a very deep knowledge of our Product organization, methods, and culture

4469763425.desc:
Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.
 About JetBrains
 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.
 What You’ll Do
 As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.
This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.
 Day To Day, You Will
 Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.

Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.

Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
Core Experience shapes how millions of people discover, choose, and enjoy what to play on Spotify every day. Within Core Experience, our What to Play team builds the technology and shared capabilities that help Spotify deliver intuitive, reliable, and consistent listening experiences.
We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to shape the systems behind these experiences, from content distribution and mobile app architecture to shared user interface capabilities.  Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area, connecting technical investments to listener needs and Spotify's broader goals.
 Partner with engineering teams to explore technical solutions, evaluate trade-offs, and guide decisions that improve product performance, reliability, and scalability.
 Develop shared platform capabilities that help teams build consistent, high-quality experiences across Spotify.
 Improve the adoption and long-term value of platform capabilities by gathering feedback, measuring outcomes, and supporting teams that use them.
 Balance new product opportunities with technical improvements, including system performance, quality, simplification, and platform migrations.
 Collaborate with Design, Data Science, and User Research to understand user needs, define success measures, and make informed product decisions.
 Use experimentation, prototypes, technical exploration, and feedback to test ideas, learn quickly, and adapt your approach.
 Build alignment across teams by communicating priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly, helping partners work toward shared outcomes.

About The Role
 We are looking for a Product Manager to own the marketing agent layer as a product: the agents marketers interact with, the marketing workflows those agents execute, and the context that makes agentic output reliable. You will treat the marketing organization as your user base and the agent layer as your product.
This is a build-together role. The agent layer runs on an orchestration and execution tier owned by the Marketing Automation team. You articulate which workflows go agentic, in what order, and why; the Automation team decides how agents are allowed to act in systems of record and owns the path from prototype to production. You bring the product discipline, the user understanding and the delivery cadence. The ideal candidate has shipped AI in internal systems teams, has product ownership experience, and understands how a B2B marketing organization plans, executes, and measures campaigns.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.
Key Responsibilities
 Own the product roadmap for the marketing agent layer: prioritize use cases by business impact, feasibility and risk, and propose delivery sequencing
 Map marketing processes end to end, identify where agents remove or reshape steps, and publish the target-state process before an agent is built
 Write requirements, acceptance criteria, and success metrics for each agent workflow, and define the system actions each workflow needs
 Co-author the agent governance standard with other marketing technology teams
 Run cross-functional forums to surface dependencies, resolve blockers and keep Marketing, Data and platform teams aligned
 Own user communication and backlog impact when agents fail
 Measure and report adoption, roadmap status, risks and decisions to stakeholders from individual contributors to executives in plain language
 Drive adoption across marketing with enablement, documentation, office hours and feedback loops
 Required
 Skills and Qualifications
 7+ years in Product Management, Marketing Technology, Marketing Operations or Platform roles
 Working knowledge of MCP-based integrations, agent frameworks and LLM APIs and how they connect to enterprise systems
 Understanding of the marketing stack (marketing automation, CRM, CDP, product analytics, orchestration and BI) and how marketing teams use it end to end
 Track record of taking a capability from prototype to adopted standard across a large organization, with evidence that adoption persisted
 Comfort working with data: defining KPIs, querying or reading analytics, and using data to make prioritization decisions
 Track record of delivering through teams you do not manage: aligning platform owners, engineers and security on a shared design and keeping momentum without direct authority
 Clear written and verbal communication across technical and business audiences
 Preferred
 Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS or developer-focused company with a product-led or consumption business model
 Hands-on experience building agent workflows: writing and iterating prompts, structuring context, defining tools, and evaluating output quality
 Experience with Marketo, Salesforce, Segment, Mixpanel or Adobe Experience Cloud
 Experience with workflow automation and integration platforms (for example Workato) or building internal tooling on them
 Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, data privacy requirements and model risk management

Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About The Team
 Stripe Terminal helps our users extend their online presence to the physical world. The Terminal team’s mission is to make accepting in-person payments as easy as accepting online payments with the Stripe API. With Terminal, businesses can unlock in-person payment use cases that fit their business model, whether that’s creating a superb retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point of sale at their next event.
Terminal is one of the fastest-growing products at Stripe, and we are building a uniquely powerful unified commerce platform for global enterprises. The platform offers a single integration for in-person payments, fast and low-cost cross-border money movement, AI-powered optimizations and fraud protection, reporting, and differentiated ways to pay.
What you’ll do
As the product manager responsible for enterprise success within Terminal Payments, you’ll deliver an end-to-end payments and commerce platform for enterprise users. You’ll work directly with users and partners to understand their needs, identify investments that serve multiple businesses, and turn those opportunities into products and integrations.
 Responsibilities
 Set a multi-year strategy for Terminal’s enterprise payments capabilities, build alignment, and translate that strategy into roadmaps and measurable objectives and key results
 Lead product discovery and roadmapping conversations with enterprise users, balancing their specific requirements with investments that benefit Stripe’s broader platform
 Build integrations that expand Terminal’s enterprise capabilities, including gift cards, private-label credit cards, tax refunds, and third-party point-of-sale systems
 Evaluate opportunities to meet enterprise loyalty and customer relationship management needs through Stripe-built offerings, and scale host-to-host capabilities for users that operate their own payment gateways
 Partner with engineering and product teams, including Core Payments, Optimized Checkout Suite, and Agentic Commerce, to deliver integrated experiences and resolve technical and product trade-offs
 Work with partnerships, marketing, legal, and industry teams on user and partner needs, go-to-market activities, and representing Terminal at trade shows and partner conferences
 Collaborate with Product Strategy and Operations to deliver in-person support and installation services for enterprise users

Description
 Every package Amazon delivery depends on an accurate transit time estimate. The Transit Time Authority (TTA) program is the single source of truth that vends those estimates to internal customers across design, scheduling, routing, Amazon Fulfilled Network, and Amazon Freight. As Amazon invests heavily in accelerating same-day and next-day delivery, TTA plays a critical role in making that speed possible. As a Sr Product Manager on this team, you will own the downstream integration of transit-time models into scheduling and routing systems. You will partner with tech and science teams to translate increasingly accurate transit-time data into real operational improvements, driving trade-off decisions between speed, cost, and delivery accuracy that shape how the network performs. This role sits alongside a second Product Manager who owns the upstream model development, giving you a clear scope focused on adoption, system integration, and measurable business outcomes for internal customers across network design, planning, and operations.
Key job responsibilities
 Own the product strategy for integrating transit-time model outputs into downstream scheduling and routing systems, defining requirements and priorities based on business impact and operational data.
 Evaluate technical proposals across ML model design, system integrations, and data pipelines, ensuring trade-off decisions between speed, cost, and delivery accuracy are well-informed and clearly communicated.
 Lead cross-functional delivery with tech, science, and business partners, driving alignment across teams with different priorities and influencing strategic direction.
 Maintain TTA infrastructure for EU. Identify opportunities to apply generative AI tools to accelerate insight generation, automate analytics workflows, and improve team productivity while applying responsible AI practices.
 Define success criteria and performance metrics for transit-time adoption, monitor operational health post-launch and benefits, and drive continuous improvement through data analysis and stakeholder feedback.
 A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing transit-time performance dashboards and flagging anomalies that need investigation. From there, you could join a working session with scheduling and routing engineers to define integration requirements for a new model granularity. After lunch, you prepare a trade-off proposal for business stakeholders, quantifying how a change in transit-time strategy would affect cost and delivery speed. Later, you sync with the science team on an upcoming model update and draft acceptance criteria for the next release.
 About The Team
 The Transit Time Authority team provides the transit-time inputs that power scheduling, routing, and network design across Amazon's middle-mile network. We work directly with North American tech and science teams to improve model accuracy and expand coverage to new business flows. The organization is investing in speed, and our team is a key driver of that effort. Previous team members have grown into Technical Product Management roles based on the depth of technical work here. If you want to solve complex optimization problems with real operational impact, we would welcome you on the team.
